structural_change: ovd split (Claude group-B r2/B3 10-14): qw_ovd_ref-w2 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (GRT markers 16,481 -> 17,243): the 64x512 SRAM sat between the 4 x 1,024-b gather pins (W/S/N-west) and x (E) -> >= 1,600 b through two ~44-um channels (cut 0.75) and ~2,600 b of W-face fan-in in a 38.7-um W channel (2.6). The data head held two flows that share no signal (gather -> x; yc -> SRAM -> write beats), so it is split into ot_hgi_qw_ovg (gather, no macro) and ot_hgi_qw_ovs (SRAM + write side) with no seam and the same registers / reset relay depth: quant_wide_ov composition exact m0 PASS 3,328 words 184 cycles (= one-leaf 184/168), sk / w3 PASS, m1 / w1 / r2 mutants FAIL (EPYC4 gb3-ovsplit). This leaf: result capture, 64x512 SRAM FIFO, meta FIFO, write credits / issue / beat registers, write grant (no gather pins: the W channel is empty).
